item.description:
Reopen Screenshottr from the Dock

  • Clicking the Dock icon after closing the main window now brings the editor back with your current project and edits.
  • Restore minimized editors and reopen the workspace even when Settings is still open.
  • Use Window → Show Screenshottr (⌘0) to bring the editor forward at any time.

Choose your Apple device frames

  • Download only the device packs you want: iPhone 17 and Air, iPhone Duo, iPad Pro, MacBook Pro, or Apple Watch Ultra.
  • See each pack’s download size, the selected total, and which packs are already installed.
  • Add more packs later without downloading your existing packs again.
  • Import just the selected Apple DMGs while preserving existing frames, projects, and styles.

Apple device frames

  • Get all 65 Apple device frames directly from Apple using Get Apple Frames in the frame sidebar.
  • Install iPhone, iPad, MacBook Pro, and Apple Watch artwork with progress, cancellation, and integrity checks.
  • Import the five Apple DMGs from disk if you already downloaded them.
  • Keep the existing plain frames, saved projects, styles, and personal frame library.
